screening_decisions.reason: This is a methodological study about systematic reviews of comparative test accuracy, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study evaluating OCT, HRT, or GDx for glaucoma.
Prospective/consecutive enrollment evaluating Fourier‑domain OCT (RTVue-100, spectral‑domain) diagnostic accuracy for glaucoma in high myopia. Meets criteria.
Prospective case‑control study evaluating GDx VCC (variable corneal compensation) for detecting glaucoma with localized visual field defects. Meets criteria.
Design and baseline data for a randomized controlled trial (EMGT) of IOP‑lowering treatment, not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging tests.
Retrospective evaluation of spectral‑domain OCT (SDOCT) parameter diagnostic accuracy for perimetric and preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing high‑definition OCT (spectral‑domain) GCIPL, ONH, and RNFL parameters for diagnosing perimetric and preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Narrative review of risk factors for glaucoma onset and progression; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study of imaging technologies.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic accuracy of GDx‑VCC in individuals with ≥1 risk factor for glaucoma (not population‑based). Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study using spectral‑domain OCT (RTVue‑100) to assess G/T ratio for diagnosing primary open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional prevalence study of undetected glaucoma from a population screening program; does not evaluate diagnostic accuracy of an imaging test.
Study on inter‑observer variability in optic disc evaluation; not a diagnostic accuracy study of OCT, HRT, or GDx.
Cross‑sectional study developing and validating a linear discriminant function for HRT3 to discriminate glaucomatous from healthy eyes. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing Humphrey Matrix perimetry, GDx VCC, Stratus OCT, and RNFL photography for early glaucoma diagnosis. Includes GDx VCC (eligible).
Study compares CSLO (HRT, version 3.04), SLP (GDx‑VCC), and OCT‑1 for discriminating OHT/glaucoma; GDx‑VCC is an eligible test, and HRT may be HRT3.
Multicenter cross‑sectional study evaluating HRT3 diagnostic accuracy across disc sizes and glaucoma stages. Meets criteria.
Methodological study on performance of tests for publication bias in meta‑analyses; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Observational cross‑sectional study evaluating Fourier‑domain OCT parameters for diagnosing early primary open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Study evaluating a race‑specific normative HRT‑III database for differentiating glaucomatous from normal eyes. Meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study assessing diagnostic capability of Spectralis SD‑OCT in glaucoma patients with visual field defects. Meets criteria.
Longitudinal study using nerve fiber layer photography to detect atrophy preceding field loss; does not evaluate OCT, HRT, or GDx diagnostic accuracy.
Retrospective review of glaucoma referral refinement schemes in the UK; not a study of imaging test accuracy.
Case‑control study applying Random Forests classifier to SD‑OCT measurements for discriminating glaucoma from normal eyes. Meets criteria.
Agreement study among clinicians evaluating optic disc photographs; not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging technologies.
Update/review article on HRT developments in glaucoma, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Prospective study comparing HRT version 3 diagnostic accuracy with stereophotography in early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Case‑control study (DIGS) comparing diagnostic accuracy of different SD‑OCT (RTVue) scanning areas for glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study evaluating structure‑function relationships and diagnostic ability of Cirrus SD‑OCT and GDx VCC. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic performance of GDx VCC and Spectralis SD‑OCT in eyes with atypical retardation pattern. Meets criteria.
Prospective study assessing diagnostic ability of GDx VCC in consecutively selected subjects. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing ONH parameters measured by Cirrus SD‑OCT and HRT3 in healthy and glaucoma eyes. Meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study comparing ONH parameters of Cirrus SD‑OCT and HRT3 for diagnostic accuracy. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating SD‑OCT ONH, RNFL, and GCC parameters for detecting preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic abilities of three SD‑OCT instruments (Cirrus, RTVue, 3D‑OCT) for glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating Topcon 3D SD‑OCT macular and peripapillary parameters in healthy, preperimetric, and early glaucoma eyes. Meets criteria.

Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic abilities of GDx VCC, HRT II, and Stratus OCT for glaucoma. Includes GDx VCC (eligible). HRT II and Stratus OCT are older versions, but study provides eligible GDx VCC data.
Design and baseline characteristics of a randomized treatment trial (CIGTS), not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Observational cross‑sectional study comparing GDx VCC with RNFL photography for glaucoma detection. Meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic value of GDx VCC in a Taiwanese population. Meets criteria.
Study comparing diagnostic accuracy of RTVue FD‑OCT and GDx‑VCC/ECC in healthy, ocular hypertensive, preperimetric, and perimetric glaucoma eyes. Meets criteria.
Case‑control study using progressive optic disc change as reference standard for evaluating GDx VCC diagnostic accuracy. Meets criteria.
Study applying wavelet‑Fourier analysis to GDx‑VCC polarimetry data for glaucoma diagnosis across stages. Meets criteria.
Caucasian referral population study evaluating diagnostic accuracy of RTVue‑100 FD‑OCT RNFLT, GCC, and optic disc parameters. Meets criteria.
Survey of UK ophthalmologists on use of investigations for glaucoma management; not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Description of a SAS macro for meta‑analysis of diagnostic accuracy studies; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Case‑control study training RVM and SVM classifiers on GDx VCC RNFL measurements for glaucoma classification. Meets criteria.

Cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic ability of HRT‑II, OCT, and GDx VCC in open‑angle glaucoma. GDx VCC is eligible; HRT‑II and OCT (likely time‑domain) are older, but study includes eligible GDx VCC.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating glaucoma discriminating ability of segmented Cirrus SD‑OCT macular scans. Meets criteria.
Revised tool for quality assessment of diagnostic accuracy studies (QUADAS‑2); not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Case‑control study creating a multivariable predictive model from SD‑OCT parameters for early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating influence of RNFL defect topography on diagnostic performance of Cirrus SD‑OCT GCIPL parameters in preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Study comparing diagnostic accuracy of GDx VCC, HRT I, and clinical assessment. GDx VCC is eligible; HRT I is older but the study provides eligible GDx VCC data.
Cross‑sectional study (Macular Ganglion Cell Imaging Study) evaluating diagnostic accuracy of Cirrus HD‑OCT GCIPL, RNFL, and ONH parameters. Meets criteria.
Prospective study evaluating SD‑OCT RNFL thickness normative database shift for early glaucoma detection. Meets criteria.
Design paper for the Advanced Glaucoma Intervention Study (AGIS), a surgical treatment trial, not diagnostic accuracy of imaging.
Evaluation comparing diagnostic capability of HRT2 and HRT3 in an Indian population. Includes HRT3 (eligible).
Population‑based study (Rotterdam Study) evaluating OCT parameters as a diagnostic/screening tool for glaucoma. Excluded as a population‑based screening study.
Cohort study on progression of untreated glaucoma in St. Lucia; does not evaluate diagnostic accuracy of imaging tests.
Prospective controlled study comparing glaucoma detection capability of Cirrus SD‑OCT and GDx‑VCC deviation maps in early localized visual field loss. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing GDx VCC parameters between POAG and PACG and evaluating diagnostic accuracy. Meets criteria.
Retrospective cross‑sectional study comparing HRT3 and HRT2 diagnostic ability for discriminating glaucomatous visual field loss. Meets criteria.
Case‑control study evaluating machine learning classifiers using SD‑OCT RNFL and ONH parameters for glaucoma diagnosis. Meets criteria.
Evaluates swept‑source OCT, which is a different technology from spectral‑domain OCT; not covered by the review's eligible test versions.
Multi‑site cross‑sectional study comparing SLP‑ECC, SLP‑VCC (GDx) and OCT diagnostic accuracy for glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Review and adaptation of a glaucoma staging system based on visual fields; not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging.
Prospective study comparing diagnostic performance of HRT3 GPS and MRA in primary open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cohort study comparing FD‑OCT GCC parameters between NTG and POAG and evaluating diagnostic ability. Meets criteria.
Development of the QUADAS quality assessment tool for diagnostic accuracy studies; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Methodological paper on hierarchical regression for meta‑analysis of diagnostic test accuracy; not a primary study.
Cross‑sectional survey and audit of quality of glaucoma referral letters; not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging.
Study on measurement error of visual field tests; not evaluating accuracy of OCT, HRT, or GDx for glaucoma diagnosis.
Cross‑sectional study comparing SD‑OCT macular inner retinal layer thickness with peripapillary RNFL thickness for glaucoma discrimination in NTG. Meets criteria.
Examination of Glaucoma Hemifield Test repeatability in automated perimetry; not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging.
Observational cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic abilities of SD‑OCT RNFL and macular inner retina parameters in Indian eyes with early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Unification of models for meta‑analysis of diagnostic accuracy studies; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Cohort study evaluating capability of FD‑OCT GCC and ONH parameters for detecting structural damage in preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Case‑control study comparing LDA and ANN for glaucoma diagnosis using GDx VCC measurements in a Taiwanese population. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing GDx VCC and Stratus OCT diagnostic abilities in chronic glaucoma. GDx VCC is eligible; Stratus OCT is time‑domain, but study includes eligible GDx VCC.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating SLP‑VCC parameters for discriminating healthy and glaucomatous eyes. Meets criteria.
Decision‑model‑based economic evaluation and value‑of‑information analysis regarding a glaucoma screening trial; not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Narrative review describing SD‑OCT technology and its performance; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Cross‑sectional study comparing ONH analysis and diagnostic accuracy between HRT3 and RTVue‑100 SD‑OCT. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic power of FD‑OCT optic disc, peripapillary RNFL, and macular inner retinal layer parameters. Meets criteria.
Prospective study evaluating SD‑OCT GCC, peripapillary RNFL, and ONH parameters for detecting localized defects in preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic ability of GDx ECC and RTVue SD‑OCT RNFL and GCC parameters. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing SD‑SLO/OCT and Stratus OCT for glaucoma detection. SD‑SLO/OCT is spectral‑domain, meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study evaluating HRT3 GPS versus MRA diagnostic accuracy in open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.

Health technology assessment report evaluating older HRT and GDx (not specified as VCC) for detecting glaucoma; likely uses outdated test versions and is not a primary diagnostic accuracy study per se.
Cross‑sectional study comparing glaucoma detection ability of Cirrus SD‑OCT GCIPL and peripapillary RNFL thickness in high myopia. Meets criteria.
Study investigating validity for population screening using time‑domain and spectral‑domain OCT; population‑based screening component excluded.
Cross‑sectional observational study comparing diagnostic accuracy of SLP‑ECC and SLP‑VCC parameters for glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic ability of Cirrus HD‑OCT neuroretinal rim assessment for glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Case‑control study comparing diagnostic performance of Cirrus HD‑OCT GCIPL, RNFL, and ONH parameters in early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Observational cohort study evaluating relationship between GCIPL thickness and estimated RGC counts with diagnostic performance assessment using HD‑OCT. Meets criteria.
Prospective study comparing operator‑dependent (MRA) and operator‑independent (GPS) classification with HRT‑III and race‑specific databases. Meets criteria.
Systematic review and economic evaluation of screening for open‑angle glaucoma; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Prospective longitudinal study identifying risk factors for visual field progression in open‑angle glaucoma; does not evaluate diagnostic accuracy of imaging.
Prospective cross‑sectional study evaluating Cirrus HD‑OCT RNFL thickness deviation map for glaucoma detection. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic ability of SD‑OCT RNFL maps versus circumpapillary RNFL thickness for detecting localized RNFL defects. Meets criteria.
Diagnostic case‑control study comparing accuracies of Spectralis, Cirrus, and RTVue SD‑OCT devices for glaucoma detection. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating GDx‑VCC performance in discriminating normal from eyes with early visual field loss. Meets criteria.
Cohort study comparing SD‑OCT RNFL, ONH, and macular measurements for detecting preperimetric glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Study examining relationship between optic disc torsion and OCT thickness measurements; not primarily a diagnostic accuracy study for glaucoma.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating impact of diabetic retinopathy on RNFL measurement and diagnostic power of GDx‑VCC and StratusOCT for glaucoma. Includes GDx‑VCC (eligible).
Prospective cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic performance of Cirrus HD‑OCT GCIPL parameters individually and combined in early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Multicentre prospective study on photographic screening for diabetic macular oedema, not glaucoma.
Prospective, comparative, clinic‑based case series evaluating diagnostic accuracy of GDx VCC for primary open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Critical review of staging systems for optic nerve damage; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Cross‑sectional study comparing GDx‑VCC RNFL parameters between healthy and early/advanced glaucoma eyes, evaluating diagnostic ability. Meets criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study comparing discriminant analysis formulas and GPS of HRT3 for detection of glaucomatous ONH changes. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing diagnostic power of Stratus and Cirrus OCT in different glaucoma types; Cirrus SD‑OCT is eligible.
Cross‑sectional study comparing SD‑OCT macular GCC vs peripapillary RNFL for discriminating early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
The abstract appears mismatched (discusses cathepsin B) and does not describe a primary diagnostic accuracy study of OCT for glaucoma; likely a review or erroneous entry.
Cross‑sectional study comparing GDx VCC and StratusOCT for RNFL assessment and diagnostic ability in preperimetric and perimetric glaucoma. GDx VCC is eligible.
Cross‑sectional study comparing Cirrus HD‑OCT and spectral OCT/SLO for glaucoma diagnosis. Meets criteria.
Systematic review and meta‑analysis of screening tests for open‑angle glaucoma; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Cross‑sectional study comparing SD‑OCT and GDx ECC RNFL parameters for glaucoma diagnosis. Meets criteria.
Brief review article on primary open‑angle glaucoma; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study of imaging.
Discussion of sources of bias in studies of optic disc and RNFL morphology; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Diagnostic accuracy study comparing HRT MRA and GPS with physician grading of optic disc photographs. Likely uses HRT3 (GPS).
Cross‑sectional study evaluating diagnostic ability of SD‑OCT macular and peripapillary RNFL parameters for early glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Analysis of baseline predictors in the Ocular Hypertension Treatment Study; not a diagnostic accuracy study of imaging.
Development of a new visual field staging system (GSS 2); not a study of imaging test accuracy.
Observational cross‑sectional study evaluating influence of disc size on diagnostic accuracy of Cirrus HD‑OCT, GDx‑VCC, and HRT3. Meets criteria.

Population‑based cross‑sectional study (high‑risk subjects) comparing MRA and GPS of HRT3 for detecting glaucomatous optic nerve damage. Meets criteria (not population‑based screening, high‑risk participants).
Prospective cross‑sectional study comparing deviation map algorithm and pRNFL thickness of Cirrus HD‑OCT for detecting localized visual field defects. Meets criteria.
Comparative diagnostic study of Cirrus OCT and GDx VCC for glaucoma diagnosis. Meets criteria.
Multicenter evaluation of diagnostic accuracy of clinical assessment vs GDx‑VCC and HRT I for glaucoma. GDx‑VCC is eligible; HRT I data not eligible, but study provides GDx‑VCC accuracy.
Prospective cross‑sectional study comparing Pulsar perimetry, FDT, GDx VCC, and HRT II for early glaucoma diagnosis. GDx VCC is eligible.
Study comparing ability of SLP with variable vs fixed corneal compensation (GDx VCC) to discriminate healthy and glaucomatous eyes. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating effect of disc size and severity on diagnostic capability of Stratus OCT, GDx VCC, and HRT II. GDx VCC eligible.
Cross‑sectional study evaluating applicability of SD‑OCT GCC parameters (RTVue) to detect glaucomatous eyes. Meets criteria.
Prospective study evaluating diagnostic accuracy of HRT III MRA and GPS classifications in a Turkish population with primary open‑angle glaucoma. Meets criteria.
Observational cross‑sectional study evaluating ability of SD‑OCT peripapillary RNFL thickness to identify early glaucoma in Asian Indian eyes. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing Cirrus and Stratus OCT for detecting localized RNFL defects in preperimetric glaucoma. Cirrus SD‑OCT is eligible.
Cross‑sectional study comparing two SD‑OCT devices (Cirrus and 3D OCT) for detecting localized RNFL defects. Meets criteria.
Retrospective case‑control series evaluating asymmetry of macular inner retinal layers measured by SD‑OCT for glaucoma diagnosis. Meets criteria.
Cross‑sectional study comparing GDx with fixed and variable corneal compensator for discriminating early glaucoma. GDx VCC is the variable compensator; meets criteria.

Observational cross‑sectional study combining structural (including GDx and OCT) and functional tests for glaucoma detection. The abstract does not specify test versions, but likely includes GDx VCC (NFI) and OCT; diagnosed based on standard. Include with caveat of possible older versions.
Case‑control study evaluating the effect of spectrum bias on diagnostic accuracy of SD‑OCT; uses SD‑OCT, meets criteria.
Methodology paper on bivariate meta‑analysis of sensitivity and specificity; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
